title: SELECTION OF Architects / Architectural Firms for providing architectural designs and services towards Development of Research Park and associated facilities at IIT Bhilai
tendering_authority: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai)
scope_summary: This tender seeks architectural firms for design services for a Research Park at IIT Bhilai, encompassing BIM modeling, sustainability assessment, quantity surveying, and cost estimation. The selected firm will be responsible for preparing all drawings in BIM/RIVET and conducting clash detection.

title: GeM Bid for 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per MHA QRs
scope_summary: This GeM tender is for the procurement of a 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) Quality Requirements. MSEs and Startups are eligible for relaxation in experience criteria.

title: NALCO GeM Tender 2026 for VR Training Module at Smelter Plant, Angul
tendering_authority: NALCO (National Aluminium Company Limited) via GeM
scope_summary: NALCO has released a GeM tender for the development and commissioning of a VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at its Angul Smelter Plant. The project aims to strengthen industrial safety training through immersive AR/VR-based simulations, SOP-based learning, PTM simulator operations, hazard identification, emergency workflows and performance analytics.
